questions.text: “Demand is a symbol of a nation's progress.” Justify the statement
questions.text_as_printed: “Demand is a symbol of a nation's progress.” Justify the statement (D)

answer.value:
Impact of Demand on Production:
Demand significantly affects the production sector.
Increased demand leads to higher production, employment, income, and supply.
It improves people's standard of living.
It leads to increase the national income and progress of country
The decrease in the demand reduces the production, income, and employment, lowering living standards and national progress.
Thus, demand is a symbol of national progress.

questions.text: Explain the relationship between utility and satisfaction.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the relationship between utility and satisfaction. (D)

answer.value:
Utility is not satisfaction; it is the power to give satisfaction.
Satisfaction is the result of utility; that is, goods and services having utility give us satisfaction.
Utility is not related to usefulness.
Though both words are often used in the same sense, it is not correct.
For example, intoxicating substances may have no benefit, yet they possess utility.
Primary utility, form utility, time utility, and place utility.

questions.text: Cooperative system is a good system in the economy. Why?
questions.text_as_printed: Cooperative system is a good system in the economy. Why? (D)

answer.value:
The cooperative system is a unique system in which people voluntarily come together and work on the basis of equality to protect their economic interests; its main aim is self-help. There is no scope for competition here.
All transactions are managed by the members themselves; profits are shared, suitable dividends are given on shares, and bonus is given based on the purchases made by members. There is no place for middlemen. There is no scope for exploitation.
Elected directors manage the affairs of the institution.
Here, members are both owners and workers.

questions.text: Explain the role of national income in a country's economy.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the role of national income in a country's economy. (A)

answer.value:
The size of national income depends on production.
If production increases, national income increases (based on population).
Increasing national income indicates the development of the nation and the standard of living of the people.
Rising national income is a sign of a country's economic progress.
Declining national income shows the country's poor economic condition and the low standard of living of its people.
For this reason, all countries continuously strive to increase their national income.

questions.text: Per capita income determines the economic condition of a country. How?
questions.text_as_printed: Per capita income determines the economic condition of a country. How? (D)

answer.value:
Per capita income is obtained by dividing the national income of a country by its total population. If national income is high, per capita income will also be high.
The standard of living of the people will be good, and as a result, people lead a comfortable life.
When national income is low, per capita income also decreases.
The standard of living of the people becomes low.
Poverty and diseases spread, and people struggle to lead their lives.
By comparing the per capita income of people in different countries, the economic condition of a country is determined.
